name: Australian Sports Commission — AusPlay Data Tables
detail: January–December 2025 activity participation tables, released 30 April 2026. State activity rates are estimates for adults aged 15+ who participated at least once in the previous 12 months.

name: Tourism Research Australia — Cycle Tourism in Australia
detail: Published October 2025; report describes 2024 trips that included a cycling activity. If a trip included cycling, all nights and spending on that trip are counted; totals are not spending caused only by cycling.

name: Tourism Research Australia — Domestic Tourism Statistics
detail: June quarter 2026 compared with June quarter 2025, and year ending June 2026 compared with year ending June 2025. General domestic tourism, not adventure-specific.

name: Geoscape Australia — Administrative Boundaries
detail: State and territory boundaries in GDA2020, August 2020 release supplied by the user; geometry simplified for web delivery.
